QuestInfo.name: Eos Tower Threatened!
QuestInfo.1: Marcel wants you to take out #r25 Block Golems#k and #r25 King Block Golems#k that live from #b#m221020000# to #b#m221020700##k.
QuestInfo.2: You took out the #rBlock Golems#k and #rKing Block Golems#k. The tower seems to be safe, but you can't help but wonder...

0.0: Oh, hello! I've been waiting for you, actually, because something serious has occurred here. A group of unruly monsters have come to threaten and actually destroy Eos Tower and Ludibrium. I was wondering if you can help us out here ...

yes.0: That's good! Now, there were some blocks leftover when Eos Tower was built. Unfortunately, those blocks were exposed to some dark energy and became nasty, destructive Golems. It'll be dangerous, but we need you to take some out.
yes.1: Take out #r25 #o4230109##k monsters and #r25 #o4230110##k monsters, which can be found between #b#m221020000# and #b#m221020700##k. Good luck!

no.0: Really. This task isn't that difficult, and I think you can do it. If you have any free time, then come talk to me.

1.0: I can't believe you took care of all those unruly Golems! How was it? They didn't destroy Eos Tower to the point of no return, did they? Anyway, I can't thank you enough for this. I'll give you this item that's essential for hunting, so please accept it!

yes.0: Did you like the reward? Thank you so much for your effort. Eos Tower will be safer than it was before you came here, but what is this weird feeling... I don't know, but just to make sure, if you have any time available, please drop by.

mob.0: I don't think you did what I asked of you. Please head to Eos Tower and take out #r25 #o4230109##k monsters and #r25 #o4230110##k monsters.
